registered: 2026-11-15, committed and pushed before any result was computed
source_of_rule: TikTok AI-generated video (samooalgo, 'Square of Nine simplified', gold). Shown: base = previous close; step = sqrt(close)/2; lines at close +/- step multiples; 'rejection candle at the line = confirmation'; 'strong close beyond the line = break' toward the next line. Examples were illustrative drawings, not recorded trades.

assumptions_not_in_video (fixed once, no.instrument_bars: SPX cash index, 5-minute closed bars, XNYS regular session only (1m data aggregated to 5m).
assumptions_not_in_video (fixed once, no.base: P = close of the last regular-session 5m bar of the immediately preceding XNYS session; a day whose preceding session is missing is skipped.
assumptions_not_in_video (fixed once, no.rejection (fade): Level above the bar open: bar high >= L and close < L -> SHORT. Level below the bar open: bar low <= L and close > L -> LONG.
assumptions_not_in_video (fixed once, no.break (continuation): Bar open below L and close >= L + 0.25*S -> LONG. Bar open above L and close <= L - 0.25*S -> SHORT.
assumptions_not_in_video (fixed once, no.priority: If one bar produces several setups, use the level nearest the bar close; break takes precedence over rejection at the same level.
assumptions_not_in_video (fixed once, no.stop: 0.25*S beyond the level against the trade (LONG: L - 0.25*S; SHORT: L + 0.25*S).
assumptions_not_in_video (fixed once, no.target: One step from the level in the trade direction (LONG: L + S; SHORT: L - S).
assumptions_not_in_video (fixed once, no.exit: First of stop/target on later bars; stop first if both in one bar (worst case); gap through stop fills at the bar open; otherwise exit at the session's last bar close. Skip the trade if the entry open is already beyond the stop or target.
assumptions_not_in_video (fixed once, no.position: One open trade at a time; each (level, setup) can fire once per session; no new entries in the last 15 minutes.

data: research/objective_review_20261107/opening_validation_raw.json.gz (116 previously consumed sessions 2026-05-19..2026-11-04; 5m before 2026-09-14, 1m after). Sessions >= 2026-11-05 are NOT used (reserved for another frozen test). No new data.

controls.C_vol: Same rules with S_vol = 0.5 x previous session high-low range (volatility-normalized step), same anchor P.
controls.C_anchor: Same rules and Gann step S, anchor shifted by a random phase u*S, u ~ Uniform(-0.5, 0.5) per session; 200 draws, seed 1501; report the distribution of test net.

metrics: trades, net points after costs, expectancy per trade, max drawdown of the chronological cumulative net curve, session-cluster bootstrap 95% CI of expectancy (2000 draws, seed 1502).

verdict_on_test_block_at_cost_1.SUCCESS: net > 0 AND bootstrap 95% lower bound of expectancy > 0 AND net > C_vol net AND net > 95th percentile of C_anchor nets
verdict_on_test_block_at_cost_1.FAILURE: net <= 0, OR net not above C_vol, OR net not above the C_anchor median
